meta.title: About Us — Sfurti
meta.description: Why Sfurti exists and our core mission for children's cognitive growth

hero.headline: Why Sfurti Exists
hero.subheadline: We believe tactile, hands-on play is the foundation for deep attention and problem-solving skills.

origin.headline: Our Origin
origin.body: In today's fast-paced digital environment, parents face a common struggle: keeping children engaged without relying solely on screens. Sfurti was born to create thoughtful, physical alternatives crafted for families in Bangladesh.

mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.statement: To reduce passive screen dependence in children by offering high-quality wooden cognitive toys that foster patience, logic, and creative problem-solving.

team.headline: Who We Are
team.body: We are a group of parents, designers, and educators passionate about restoring intentional physical play to childhood.

philosophy.headline: Our Design Philosophy
philosophy.body:
1. No over-stimulating plastic noise or screens.
2. Smooth, non-toxic, eco-friendly natural wood.
3. Purposeful cognitive mechanisms built into every design.
